data_fields.name: rotate_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.2 (per event, SDL dTheta; unit not verified)

best_idea: Classify each touch gesture by finger count and per-event motion (one finger selects, two fingers pan unless they twist past a threshold, three fingers swipe), latch the twist until the finger lifts, and show a touched enemy's HP while the finger stays down.
decision_why: The finger-count table and the latched twist fit a phone-first Pit and zone view; the donor's formation rotation and console swipe do not fit Frankendom, so they are not taken.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone: one finger tap selects an enemy as target (no box); two fingers that do not twist pan the zone view; a twist beyond the threshold stays a twist until the finger lifts; a single touch on an enemy shows that enemy's HP until the finger lifts.
